sloka: जनकानाम् कुले कीर्तिम् आहरिष्यति मे सुता ।सीता भर्तारम् आसाद्य रामम् दशरथ आत्मजम् ॥१-६७-२२॥
transliteration: janakānām kule kīrtim āhariṣyati me sutā ।sītā bhartāram āsādya rāmam daśaratha ātmajam ॥1-67-22॥

translations.english: By receiving Rama, son of Dasaratha, as her husband, my daughter Sita will bring glory to my dynasty.
